title: LangBot
oneLiner: Production-grade platform for building agentic IM bots across Discord, Slack, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, and more.
summary: LangBot is an open-source AI bot project focused on production-grade platform for building agentic im bots across discord, slack, telegram, line, wechat, feishu, dingtalk, and more.
whyItMatters: LangBot matters because many useful agents will not live only inside an IDE or web app. They need to work inside the communication channels people already use, with source code that can be inspected, self-hosted, and adapted around privacy, permissions, memory, and operational controls.
bestFor: Builders evaluating self-hosted AI bots for real messaging channels
Teams comparing Discord, Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, Matrix, or WeChat AI assistant options
Developers who want open-source bot infrastructure instead of closed chatbot SaaS
notFor: Teams unwilling to review bot permissions, channel credentials, and data retention policies
Users who only need a hosted consumer chatbot with no deployment work

coreStrengths.title: Lives in existing communication channels
coreStrengths.description: LangBot brings AI assistance into messaging surfaces rather than forcing users into a separate app.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Bots become useful when they meet users where coordination already happens.

coreStrengths.title: Self-hostable source path
coreStrengths.description: The public repository lets teams inspect runtime behavior, credentials handling, and integration choices before deployment.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: AI bots can see sensitive conversations, so source review and controlled hosting matter.

coreStrengths.title: Good comparison target for agent gateways
coreStrengths.description: The project shows how open bots connect LLMs, permissions, plugins, memory, or channel adapters.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: These patterns are likely to become a core part of practical open-agent infrastructure.

useCaseNotes.title: Team chat AI assistant
useCaseNotes.description: Deploy or study LangBot as a starting point for AI help inside messaging channels.

useCaseNotes.title: Personal always-on bot
useCaseNotes.description: Evaluate whether its channel support, model support, and hosting model fit a private personal assistant workflow.

useCaseNotes.title: Agent gateway prototype
useCaseNotes.description: Use the project to compare how bots handle message routing, model calls, plugins, and long-running tasks.

compareNotes.title: When to choose LangBot
compareNotes.summary: Choose it when its official repository shows the workflow, license, and integration model you need more directly than a broad framework.
